spans.s: द्वि (˚—) two.
1 द्विक a. consisting of two, two.
2 द्विक m. a crow (cf. काक).
द्विकर्मक a. having two objects or accusatives (g.).
द्विगु m. a cert. class of compounds (g.).

द्वि॑गुण a. double, twofold, twice as much as (abl. or
—˚);
 द्विगुण & द्विगुणतर (˚—) adv., also n. ˚तरम्. Abstr.
˚ता† f., ˚त्व† n.

द्विगुण॑ a. double, twofold, twice as much as (abl. or
—˚);
 द्विगुण & द्विगुणतर (˚—) adv., also n. ˚तरम्. Abstr.
˚ता† f., ˚त्व† n.
द्विगुणी@कृ = prec. act., ˚भू = prec. pass.
द्विजा॑ a. twice or doubly born.
द्विजधर्मिन् a. having the duties of the twice-born.

द्विजर्षभ m. chief (lit. bull) of the twice-born, a
Brahman.
द्विजर्षि m. = बह्मर्षि.

द्विजलिङ्गिन् a. wearing the external marks of a
Brahman.
द्विजवत्सल a. fond of Brahmans.
द्विजवर m. a Brahman (best of the twice-born).
द्विज˚श्रेष्ठ m. a Brahman (best of the twice-born).
द्विज˚सत्तम m. a Brahman (best of the twice-born).
द्विजाग्र्य m. a Brahman (chief of the twice-born).
द्विजाग्र्यार्चा f. the veneration of Brahmans.
द्विजादि m. Brahman and so on, i.e. caste.
द्विजा॑नि a. having two wives.

द्वि॑जिह्व a. two-tongued, double-tongued (lit. & fig.);
m. a snake.
द्विजेन्द्र m. a Brahman (chief of the twice-born).
द्विजेश्वर m. a Brahman (chief of the twice-born).
द्विजोत्तम m. a Brahman (chief of the twice-born).

द्विट्सेविन् a. serving the enemy;
 m. a traitor.
द्वित॑ m. N. of a Vedic god & of a Ṛṣi.
द्विता॑ adv. just so, so also, likewise.

द्वितय a. consisting of two, twofold, double, pl. both;
n. a pair.

द्विती॑य a. second, n. adv. secondly, for the second time.
— m. companion, fellow, follower, friend or enemy, adj. —˚ followed
by, endowed with, possessed of. f. आ female companion (*the second day
of a half-month*);
 the second case (accusative) and its endings, also a
word standing in the accusative^1 (g.).
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
द्वितीयभाग m. a half.
द्वितीयांश m. a half.
द्वित्र (& द्वित्रि) pl. two or three.

द्वित्रिचतुरभाग pl. a half, a third, or a
fourth.

द्वित्व n. doubleness, duality;
 dual or reduplication (g.).

*द्विद्रोण n. two Droṇas;
 instr. by such a measure.
द्विध a. twofold, divided or split in two.

द्विधा॑ adv. in two parts, in twain;
 w. कृ double.
द्विधाभूताकृति a. of twofold shape.
द्विधास्थित a. existing double.
द्विप m. elephant (lit. drinking twice).

द्वीप॑ m. n. island, peninsula, sandbank;
 esp. one of the
(4, 7, 13, or 18) islands or continents of which the earth is supposed
to consist.

द्वि॑पद् (˚पाद्) a. having two feet (m. man, n. mankind)
or consisting of two verses (f. द्विपाद् or द्विप॑दी), m. & f. ˚दी
such a metre.

द्विप॑द् (˚पाद्) a. having two feet (m. man, n. mankind) or
consisting of two verses (f. द्विपाद् or द्विप॑दी), m. & f. ˚दी such
a metre.
द्वि॑पाद f. ई two-footed.
द्विपदिका f. a kind of metre or tune.

द्विपदीखण्ड m. or n. a piece in Dvipadikā (v.
prec.).
द्विपारि m. lion (lit. the elephant's enemy).

द्विपेन्द्र m. a large elephant (lit. prince of the
elephants).

द्विपेश्वर m. a large elephant (lit. prince of the
elephants).

द्विबाहु a. two-armed;
 m. a man.
द्विभाग m. a half.
द्विभुज a. = द्विबाहु.
द्विमात्र a. twice as large.
द्विमासादि a. more than two months (pregnant).
द्विमुख f. ई having two mouths or faces.
द्वि॑मूर्धन् a. two-headed.

द्विरद a. two-toothed;
 m. elephant.

द्विरात्र॑ a. lasting two days;
 m. such a ceremony.

द्विरुक्त a. twice said, repeated, doubled, reduplicated;
n. = seq.
द्विरुक्ति f. repetition.

द्विरुच्चारित n. the repeated execution (of a musical
piece).
द्विरूप॑ a. bicolour, biform, twofold.
द्विरेफ m. a kind of bee.
द्विर्वचन n. repetition, reduplication.
द्विलक्ष n. a distance of 200,000 (Yojanas).
द्विलक्षण a. twofold, of two kinds.
द्विलय s. double time (tempo) or measure.
द्विवक्त्र॑ a. = द्विमुख.
द्विवचन n. the dual & its endings (g.).
द्विवर्ण a. two-coloured.
द्विवर्ष (f. ˚र्षिका) two years old.
द्विवर्ष˚क (f. ˚र्षिका) two years old.
द्विवार्षिक a. the same.
द्विविध a. twofold, ˚धा adv.
द्विशफ a. cloven- (lit. double-) footed.
द्वि॑शवस् a. doubly strong.
द्विशस् adv. two by two, in couples.
द्विशिरस् a. two-headed.
द्विशृङ्ग a. having two horns or points.

1 द्विष् द्वे॑ष्टि द्विष्टे॑ (द्विषति & द्विष˚ते), pp.
द्विष्ट (q.v.) hate, be hostile or a rival (w. acc., r. dat. or gen.).
— प्र dislike, hate, show enmity against (acc.). वि A.M. the same;
M. also hate each other mutually, be hostile towards one another. — Cf.
द्विष॑न्त्, विद्विषन्त्, विद्विषाण, विद्विष्ट.
द्विस् adv. twice (*अह्वस्, अह्वा, or अह्वि twice a day).
द्विष a. hating, disliking (—˚).
द्विषदन्न n. food from an enemy.
द्विषदायुस् m. an enemy (life-hater).

द्विष्ट a. hated, odious;
 averse, hostile.
द्विसहस्र n. two thousand.
द्विःसम a. twice as large.
द्विहायन f. ई two years old.
द्वीपिचर्मन् n. an elephant's skin.
द्वी॑प्य a. living on an island.
